# MatterSuite

> AI-powered legal operations platform providing comprehensive software solutions for matter management, accounting, document handling, and litigation tracking across law firms and corporate legal departments.

MatterSuite is an enterprise legal technology platform that combines workflow automation, AI-powered tools, and integrated financial management to streamline legal operations. The platform serves law firms, in-house legal teams, and corporate departments across multiple practice areas including IP, real estate, immigration, and litigation.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered legal operations
- Matter management
- Document management
- E-billing & LEDES/UTBMS compliance
- Legal accounting & trust accounting
- Litigation management
- Case management
- Workflow automation
- In-house legal software
- Client portal
- Contract management
- Time tracking
- Budget tracking
- Legal practice management
- Corporate legal department software
